text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a festival was being held 
nearby today. Invited by the 
festival-loving Kitasan Black, I decided 
to go with her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! The festival atmosphere really is 
the best, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yakisoba, okonomiyaki, and grilled squid! 
I wanna eat every single one from end to 
end~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... B-But if I carry the portable 
shrine after this and work up a sweat, 
then it's zero calories! Yup!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So with that, shall we be on our way, 
Trainer?♪
choice_data_list: I don't think that makes it zero calories.
Let's enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yeah, do you think so too? ...I 
guess you're right."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I'll do my best to hold back and 
stop when I'm eighty percent full!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's also fun to browse all the food 
stalls and find that "one perfect spot," 
right?♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Look! I'd like the grilled carrots 
over there!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The smell, the shine, the shape—everything 
is flawless! Mister, I'll take that one, 
please♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch, munch*...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... *gulp*.

She doesn't answer when spoken to. Kitasan 
Black just silently continues munching on 
her grilled carrot.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! That was soooo delicious~!!
choice_data_list:
You were really focused on eating, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah, were you talking to me!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I totally didn't notice! 
Whenever I'm eating carrots, I kind of get 
lost in my own world...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's rich flavors or sweet treats, 
you just can't help but crave a taste, 
haha...

Seeing Kitasan Black apologize with such 
bashfulness, I couldn't help but find it 
endearing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi! I'm going to enjoy this to the 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Misteeer! One cotton candy, please!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Do you want to split those takoyaki 
over there?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Grilled corn sounds great too~♪ Alright, 
let's get some!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah, they were all so tasty~♪ Which one 
should I eat next, I wonder?
choice_data_list: (Isn't that eating a bit too much...?)

text_block_list.text:
Wondering whether carrying the portable 
shrine would burn off the calories 
consumed... anxiety gradually began to 
mount.
